name: librejustice
description: The LibreJustice MCP connector and its skills: free French legal research, case law from France's administrative and judicial courts, and legislation as it stood on any date.

plugins.name: librejustice
plugins.description: Free and open source, LibreJustice gives your agent ~3.8 million French-language and European decisions and ~3.9 million legal articles, readable as they stood on any date and linked article by article. Four MCP tools over OAuth, two research skills.
